title: Rust, Zig and C++ stories vs Go stories on points
question: Does a story about Rust, Zig and C++ get more points than a story about Go?
author: film-cards
hypothesis: A story about Rust, Zig and C++ gets more points than a story about Go.
expect: If true, points per story for Rust, Zig and C++ stories should be at least 1.5x the value for Go stories, over all stories from 2006 to 2026 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).

check.per_label: points per story, Rust, Zig and C++ against Go

group_a.label: Rust, Zig and C++ stories ({from} to {to})

thresholds_note: Thresholds are the ones used on h370, set before this card was run and not tuned to its result. h311 is left unchanged.
caveats: Points are the score each story had when the archive fetched it, so 2025 and 2026 stories may still be gaining points.
A title that names a theme is not proof the story is about it, and one story can sit in both groups.
Both groups are title words only, so stories that never name the theme are missed.
h311 asked a different question; this card compares two groups head to head.
